title: Command Frontmatter
description: Formalizes the YAML frontmatter shape of a plugin command file (commands/<name>.md), per CLAUDE.md's 'Command and Hook Mechanics' section. Commands are real Claude Code mechanics: their frontmatter is fixed by the platform, NOT by this plugin's Skill/Agent schema. The only fields Claude Code recognizes are `description` (required), `argument-hint`, `allowed-tools`, `model`, and `disable-model-invocation`. This schema validates SHAPE ONLY — it deliberately forbids Skill/Agent-only fields (name, version, phase, owner, created, tags, role, inputs, outputs, skills) that would signal a command file mistakenly authored against the wrong component schema.

description.description: Required. One-line summary of what the command does; surfaces in the command picker.

argument-hint.description: Optional. Hint text for the arguments the command expects (e.g. '<artifact-id>'), used to split positional $0/$1... input. Either a single hint string or a list of hint strings (one per positional argument).

allowed-tools.description: Optional. Restricts which tools the command's prompt may use. Either a single tool name or a list of tool names.

model.description: Optional. Overrides the model used to run this command's prompt.

disable-model-invocation.description: Optional. When true, the command cannot be invoked by the model (SlashCommand tool) and is user-only.
